260:t_000:10.en:
$$隼人$$
「Looks like you still haven't grasped how vast space is...」

260:t_000:11.en:
$$隼人$$
「$$ワッ太$$... Do you know how many light-years it is from Earth to Pluto?」

260:t_000:13.en:
$$隼人$$
「About 40 astronomical units... That's less than 0.001 light-years.」

260:t_000:15.en:
$$赤木$$
「Then even that jump from before took us far beyond the solar system!」

260:t_000:16.en:
$$いぶき$$
「I just can't get any sense of it at all...」

260:t_000:17.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Now, now... This jump was only a test, you see. If the conditions are right, we can jump much farther.」

260:t_000:18.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Exactly. By my calculations, as long as there are no obstacles such as dimensional faults, I am confident I can handle navigation for around 100 light-years.」

260:t_000:19.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Over 100 times the distance of this jump, huh.」

260:t_000:20.en:
$$木下$$
「100 light-years means 10,000 times the distance between Earth and Pluto!」

260:t_000:22.en:
$$勝平$$
「All right! Suddenly I can see some hope!」

260:t_000:23.en:
$$柿小路$$
「The problem will be... the cost, I should think.」

260:t_000:24.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$號$$... How long does it take to store enough energy to open a wormhole?」

260:t_000:26.en:
$$恵子$$
「Even at 100 light-years at a time, if every single jump takes that many days...!」

260:t_000:27.en:
$$厚井$$
「This really is shaping up to be a journey measured in decades...」

260:t_000:28.en:
$$田中司令$$
「...Oh dear... This is not good...」

260:t_000:30.en:
$$田中司令$$
「When it rains, it pours... It seems some uninvited guests have arrived.」

260:t_002:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So those are the $$宇宙怪獣$$ of a parallel world...!」

260:t_002:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「They're nothing like the ones from our world.」

260:t_002:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(Who would have thought we'd run into them in a place like this... I can't say I'm glad about it.)

260:t_002:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...I knew it. So I was right...」

260:t_002:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$ have a habit of chasing the Vanishing Drive waves given off when something warps.」

260:t_002:6.en:
$n
「Then whenever we make hyperspace jumps from now on, they'll show up...!」

260:t_002:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...I thought the $$宇宙怪獣$$ that appeared in the $$時獄戦役$$ were just survivors who'd been transferred here, like me, but...」

260:t_002:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「If there are this many of them at the galactic center, then they must have a nest after all...!」

260:t_002:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「In the world I come from, $$宇宙怪獣$$ built their nest at the galactic center.」

260:t_002:11.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「And from there, $$宇宙怪獣$$ are born in numbers you could call infinite.」

260:t_002:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「So this world has a nest of theirs too...」

260:t_002:13.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「That is what we should conclude, judging also from the data Ensign $$レド$$ provided.」

260:t_002:14.en:
$$葵$$
「So the main force of the $$バアル$$ was lying in wait at the galactic center.」

260:t_002:15.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Now that's a surprise. So they exist across multiple parallel worlds.」

260:t_002:16.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Research and investigation can wait! Those monsters have been ready to fight for a while now!」

260:t_002:17.en:
$$赤木$$
「Damn it! We're going to be playing tag with these things all the way back to Earth!?」

260:t_002:18.en:
$$青山$$
「Just thinking about that going on for ten years gives me chills...!」

260:t_002:19.en:
$$ランド$$
「I can't be bothered thinking about ten years from now! Let's get through what's in front of us first!」

260:t_002:20.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, begin your attack. If we don't annihilate them here, they will pursue us without end.」

260:t_002:22.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Don't just stand there, $$ノノ$$! Even in a parallel world, a space monster is still a space monster!」

260:t_003:0.en:
$$ボス$$
「Swarms and swarms of 'em...! Fighting these things really makes me sick!」

260:t_003:1.en:
$$さやか$$
「No wonder they call them humanity's natural enemy!」

260:t_003:5.en:
$$凱$$
「More $$宇宙怪獣$$ coming as reinforcements!? Give me a break!」

260:t_004:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「The humans who struck down our great god, Lord $$ハーデス$$...!」

260:t_004:3.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「To think they would come to this sea of stars!」

260:t_004:4.en:
$$チコ$$
「What are those things!? Giants!? Robots!?」

260:t_004:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「They're beings who call themselves the gods of $$オリュンポス$$... Because they existed in the civilization left behind in $$ミケーネ$$ on Earth, we call them $$ミケーネ神$$s.」

260:t_004:8.en:
$$弁慶$$
「But their power truly does go far beyond human understanding.」

260:t_004:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「They came to Earth in the age of myth to get their hands on $$次元力$$, too, but...」

260:t_004:10.en:
$$甲児$$
「They were defeated by $$ゼウス$$, a god with a heart of justice even among the gods of $$オリュンポス$$, and sealed away in the land of $$ミケーネ$$.」

260:t_004:11.en:
$$隼人$$
「We fought them after their seal was broken and they revived. Then we defeated their king, $$ハーデス$$, King of the Underworld, and crushed his ambitions.」

260:t_004:12.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「That anger and hatred still dwell in our hearts!」

260:t_004:13.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Hearing that an incarnation of endless destruction had appeared, we came to defeat it, but to think we'd meet you...!」

260:t_004:14.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「A golden opportunity...! We'll bury you here, along with those $$バアル$$!」

260:t_004:15.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「How lucky for us. If those giants deal with the $$宇宙怪獣$$ for us, that's a huge help on our end.」

260:t_004:16.en:
$$シモン$$
「Don't celebrate just yet, $$ニコラ$$. Those guys are going after us too.」

260:t_004:17.en:
$$甲児$$
「We could get caught in a pincer between the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and the $$ミケーネ神$$s!」

260:t_004:18.en:
$$タケル$$
「And their power lives up to their claim of being gods...! They're in a whole different league from any enemy so far!」

260:t_004:19.en:
$n
「Damn...! Trouble on the very first jump...!」

260:t_005:1.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「So defeating Lord $$ハーデス$$ really was some kind of mistake after all!」

260:t_005:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Now, weep and beg for your lives! Cling to the mercy of the gods!」

260:t_005:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「Gods, my foot...! They think they're so great just because they're a bit stronger than humans!」

260:t_005:4.en:
$$青山$$
「Even so, it's true we're in trouble if this keeps up.」
